W.note: Restrained warm glow, slow drift and long-tail curves, solid focus and reduced-motion handling, but the glass button is a bit low-contrast at rest and the effect is subtle.

X.note: Pretty pastel aurora sweep with overshoot, but the white label washes out against the pale gradient mid-hover, hurting legibility; blur layers and transition:all add cost.

Y.note: Cheap, well-built cloud glow with a clear focus ring and tap fallback, but the hover change is modest and the small dark button reads as understated.

Z.note: Richest hover with a bloom halo, drifting blurred color and arrow reveal using gentle overshoot and slow release, while the label stays legible and reduced motion is handled.
